reviewText: Loving the UI design. Those red pulses when you get close to 77 are super tense!
Bohot sahi game hai! Perfect for quick 5-minute breaks during my commute. Smooth animations and zero lag on my phone.
Solid strategy game. The hard AI is actually challenging and makes you think twice before playing a modifier card.
Enjoying the card mechanics. It’s a nice break from standard card games and the math keeps my brain sharp.
Game is fun but the ads get a bit repetitive. Would be better if we could customize the avatar speed too.

The arithmetic challenge in this game is brilliant and keeps my brain sharp during my commute. I love how the UI changes color as the total approaches 77; it adds such a layer of tension. Runs perfectly smooth on my OnePlus without any heating issues at all. Highly recommended for anyone who loves strategic card games.

Game ka concept bahut unique hai, I really enjoy the fast-paced nature of each round. The card dealing animation is fluid and doesn't lag even when I'm playing on mobile data. Thoda aur variety of avatars add karenge toh aur maza aayega. Overall, a great way to pass time without any unnecessary complications.

Quite impressed with how lightweight this app is on my storage. The offline AI mode is surprisingly smart, especially on the hard setting where it saves those modifier cards perfectly. It's a solid strategy game, though I wish there were more deck customization options. Stable experience and very responsive touch controls.

Simple yet very addictive, especially when you are trying to force your opponent over 77. The interface is very clean, and I appreciate that the ads don't interrupt the gameplay mid-match. Mera phone thoda purana hai but still this game runs without any glitches. Good job by the developers.

Fast matches and clean logic make this a top-tier card game for quick breaks. The drag-and-flick control feels very natural, and the crisp audio cues make every turn satisfying. It's a fun strategic puzzle that rewards you for planning ahead rather than just relying on luck. Definitely keeping this one installed.
Smooth 60 fps card drag animations and great for sharpening rapid mental arithmetic. Unlocked two new card backs already using practice points. Simple, clean UI.
Numbers jaise jaise 77 ke paas aate hain screen red pulse hoti hai, tension double ho jaati hai bhai! 2-3 minute ka quick match break me khelne ke liye best hai.
Really fun concept with the 77 count limit! Holding that -10 card till the very last turn saved my match. AI offline mode works smooth without lag on my Redmi phone.
